column1: # Known random-dependent tests: product code calls Math.random behind a
# seeded settings row, so the test fails on a sampled draw (BH-9410, comment
# 6780574176). bin/lib/ci-batch-red-causes.sh calls a red merge-queue batch
# seeded-random when EVERY failing entry equals the match of a row whose
# [since, until) holds the batch time. One fragment per ticket. Columns (TAB):
# match is a failing entry of a batch record: a suite path, or job:<job name>.
# until is the merge time of the fix, or - while the test is still exposed.

column6: BH-9076 sampler; G3 fixed by BH-9430 #9462
